about.label: About PrayogShala
about.title: From a textbook diagram to a verified result. One bench, no reagents, no waiting.
about.1.title: Instruments that behave
about.1.desc: Burettes drip, springs stretch, rays bend. Each bench runs on the same physics you are examined on, so readings are honest and repeatable.
about.2.title: Curriculum mapped
about.2.desc: Every lab is tied to a SEE or +2 practical. Steps follow the standard procedure so the muscle memory transfers to the real bench.
about.3.title: Tracked and exportable
about.3.desc: Progress, readings and views are recorded on your device. Reports export to PDF for your practical file.

process.label: Process
process.title: Four steps from question to conclusion
process.subtitle: The same loop a working scientist follows, made small enough to finish in one lesson.
process.1.title: Pick the question
process.1.desc: Each lab opens with one clear question and the equipment on the bench. You know what you are trying to find before you touch anything.
process.2.title: Set up the bench
process.2.desc: Drag apparatus into place, zero instruments, add reagents. The bench refuses unsafe or out-of-order steps and tells you why.
process.3.title: Take readings
process.3.desc: Live readouts and a growing graph show every measurement. Repeat, change one variable, compare.
process.4.title: Conclude and export
process.4.desc: Compare your value with the accepted one, read the model's caveats and export a report for your file.

titration.title: Acid-Base Titration
titration.subtitle: Determine concentration of HCl using NaOH
titration.overshot.hint: Real titrations require slow, drop-by-drop addition near the endpoint. Try again!
titration.step1.title: Prepare the Burette
titration.step1.desc: Click 'Fill Burette' to fill it with 0.1M NaOH solution up to the 0 mL mark.
titration.step1.hint: In a real lab, you would rinse the burette 3 times with NaOH before filling.
titration.step2.title: Add HCl to Flask
titration.step2.desc: Click 'Add HCl' to pipette 25 mL of 0.1M HCl into the conical flask.
titration.step2.hint: Use a pipette for accurate volume measurement — not a measuring cylinder.
titration.step3.title: Add the Indicator
titration.step3.desc: Click the phenolphthalein bottle to add 2-3 drops to the flask.
titration.step3.hint: Phenolphthalein is colorless in acid and pink in base. This tells us when we've reached the endpoint.
titration.step4.title: Perform the Titration
titration.step4.desc: Open the stopcock and add NaOH slowly. Watch the pH and color change. Close the stopcock when the flask turns permanently pink.
titration.step4.hint: Near the endpoint, add NaOH one drop at a time. The permanent pink color should last 30 seconds.
